The '''Bone Pits''' was a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]]-infested cave system in the [[Tromper Crags]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], accessible via a tunnel that opened onto [[Icefinger Rise]]. By the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] established a base which connected to the tunnels. This led to [[Cipher Nine]] tapping into the walls in order to spy on a meeting between the [[Marauders (White Maw)|Marauders]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]]'s agents.
